fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) has declined 36.8% from its September peak as of November 12, with three of its past seven market shocks involving declines exceeding 40% (46% decline during 2020 COVID-19).
fields.summary_ko.1: Dell's 12-month revenue reached $151B (49% increase) and operating margin improved from 7.1% to 9.6%, though DRAM, NAND, and CPU constraints along with component supply issues persist.
fields.summary_ko.2: Total debt increased from $28.7B to $34.5B and free cash flow declined 47.22%, though shareholder returns reached a record $4.3B.
